children: The ₹428-crore initial public offering (IPO) of façade solutions provider Glass Wall Systems India Ltd. will open for subscription on September 8 and close on September 10. The company has fixed a price band of ₹172-182 per equity share.
Glass Wall Systems IPO: Anchor investors
Glass Wall Systems India raised ₹128.36 crore from anchor investors on Monday, ahead of the IPO opening.
The company allotted 70.53 lakh equity shares to anchor investors at ₹182 per share, according to a circular uploaded on the BSE website.

Investors participating in the anchor round included HDFC Mutual Fund, Bank of India Mutual Fund, Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance Company, Abakkus Growth Fund, Integrated Core Strategies (Asia) Pte Ltd, PineBridge India Equity Fund, Bengal Finance and Investment and Subhkam Ventures.
Glass Wall Systems IPO: Should you bid?
SBI Securities
: Subscribe for long term
SBI Securities has recommended subscribing to the Glass Wall Systems IPO for the long term, citing the company's established market position, integrated capabilities and strong earnings growth.

Glass Wall Systems is a façade and fenestration solutions provider with more than two decades of industry experience, with capabilities spanning design, engineering, manufacturing and project execution.
The company reported revenue, EBITDA and profit after tax (PAT) CAGRs of 22.5%, 38.7% and 103.4%, respectively, between FY24 and FY26, reflecting strong operating growth and improving profitability.
Its order book stood at ₹981 crore as of July 2026, equivalent to 2.1 times FY26 operating revenue, providing healthy revenue visibility.
SBI Securities said the proposed glass-processing unit could support margins, strengthen supply-chain control and reduce the company's dependence on third-party processors.
The acquisition of Yes Systems is also expected to strengthen its presence in the premium residential fenestration segment through the ORIA brand.

At the upper price band of ₹182, Glass Wall Systems is valued at a post-issue FY26 P/E multiple of 19.1 times. Considering its market position, technical expertise, strong earnings growth, order-book visibility and backward integration plans, SBI Securities has assigned a “Subscribe for Long Term” rating to the issue.
Anand Rathi
: Subscribe for long term
Anand Rathi has also recommended subscribing to the IPO for the long term, citing the company's integrated façade capabilities, growing international presence and backward integration plans.

Glass Wall Systems has more than two decades of experience across the design, engineering, manufacturing, supply and installation of customised façade systems. The company has established a presence in India as well as international markets such as the US and Australia.
As of March 31, 2026, the company had completed 158 projects.
At the upper price band of ₹182 per share, the company is valued at 19.1 times FY26 earnings and 14.47 times EV/EBITDA, implying a post-issue market capitalisation of around ₹1,600.4 crore.

Anand Rathi said the company's integrated façade capabilities, marquee customer base, growing international presence and backward integration into glass processing provide visibility for long-term growth.
However, the brokerage said the IPO appears fairly valued relative to its listed peer and maintained a “Subscribe - Long Term” recommendation.
Glass Wall Systems IPO: Structure and use of proceeds

The mainboard issue comprises a fresh issue of equity shares worth up to ₹60 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 2.02 crore equity shares by promoters Jawahar Hariram Hemrajani and Eshan Jawahar Hemrajani, along with investor shareholder India Business Excellence Fund IIA.

Of the fresh issue proceeds, ₹50 crore will be used to set up a glass-processing unit at the company's Vile Bhagad facility in Maharashtra as part of its planned backward integration. The remaining funds will be used for general corporate purposes.
About Glass Wall Systems India
Incorporated in 2002, Glass Wall Systems India is a façade solutions and fenestration provider with operations in the domestic market and overseas markets including the US and Australia.
The company provides customised façade systems and undertakes projects across design, engineering, manufacturing, supply and installation.
The equity shares are proposed to be listed on the BSE and NSE on September 16.
